info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: ayaM DAtuH prApaRArTe (nayanam asmin arTe) dvikarmakaH asti, yaTA 'rAmaH grAmaM BAraM vahati' iti . parantu vahanArTe (svayaM pravahati asmin arTe) akarmakaH yasti, yaTA - 'nadI vegena vahati' iti .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to flow, to propel, to carry, to  haul, to drag

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: bahanA, JaranA, QonA, Qo le jAnA
